name: The Reserve (high summer in the Tualatin Valley wine country)
note: Course theme palette (32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2, as pumpkin_ridge.json). The Reserve Vineyards & Golf Club, Aloha OR, drawn in high summer, as the OSIP 2024 photo shows it (July): irrigated turf a warm, sunlit green (photo: fairway #819462, green #939b67, mown rough #6e835d) in G3-G9; the native grass left long between the holes, wide on the links-style North course, gone blonde (photo #a29974; F0-F2, drawn where data/reserve/proposed/fescue.geojson says, config fescue_areas); the South course's bright white bunker sand (photo #d0d1c7; S0-S2); green-teal ponds (#3b4f5a; W0-W2); the dry grass fields round the course in summer gold (L0-L2); warm brown leaf litter under the oaks (B0-B1) and a claret accent for roofs (B2), the vineyard's colour. Trees: Douglas fir, and Oregon white oak, bigleaf maple and Oregon ash in full summer leaf (assets-src/trees_reserve.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
